<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-23. -->
## YouTube Music

- **A–B repeat:** Enable **RVX → Player → A–B repeat**. In Now Playing, tap **Set A** and **Set B** below the seekbar to repeat that section. You can pause or scrub to place either marker. Tap **Clear** or seek outside the section to stop repeating. Next still changes tracks, including when crossfade is on.
- **Original audio and loudness:** Under **RVX → Video**, **Prefer original audio stream** chooses a non-DRC encode when one is available for the same audio track. It keeps DRC-only tracks playable. **Disable loudness normalization** controls playback gain separately and keeps your existing setting. Neither switch changes existing downloads.
- **Player settings:** **Add to queue in tap order** and **Playback source inspector** now align with neighboring rows and follow the selected icon style. Parent-only icon mode still leaves both rows iconless.

Verified on Music 9.40.51 on a Moto Edge Plus 2023. Live tracks offered only original audio; the same-track original/DRC pair, DRC-only fallback and independent gain setting were verified separately on Android with constructed format objects. The new controls are omitted on forced Music 6.20.51.
